newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S. African bus crash toll rises to 38 - police.
newsitem.headline: S. African bus crash toll rises to 38 - police.

text.p: The death toll from a fiery crash on Saturday between a bus and a fuel tanker in South Africa stood at 38 on Sunday with 12 people in a critical condition, police said.
Spokesman Blackie Swart said rescuers had retrieved 38 bodies from the wreck of the bus carrying mourners home from a funeral.
The accident happened about 1:30 p.m. (1130 GMT) on Saturday near Warmbaths, north of Pretoria.
Witnesses told police the bus appeared to have tried to overtake another vehicle in thick smoke from a wildfire and crashed into the tanker, which was carrying diesel fuel.
Five children died late on Friday when a bus carrying a choir home from a competition left the road and plunged into a river in South Africa's Free State province.
